title: Hold a licence to carry passengers by air within NSW
what: Carry passengers by air within NSW only under a licence, and run a regular air transport service only on routes the licence covers (routes may be deregulated by order).

sources.title: Air Transport Act 1964 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person shall not carry by an aircraft from a place in New South Wales to another place in New South Wales any passengers unless: (a) the person is the holder of a licence under this Act, and (b) if the person is operating or providing a regular air transport service, the route over which the passengers are carried is a route in respect of which the licence was granted
